newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - November 1.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - November 1.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Friday. Reuter has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Taipei prisoner escapes from military hospital when receiving medical treatment.
Former Poland president Walesa, in five-day visit in Taipei, says Poland and Taiwan should strengthen cooperation.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - China will soon announce rules governing Taiwan-China trade.
Premier Lien Chan says service-oriented communities can help upgrade national competitiveness.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Commercial banks oppose Finance Ministry's strict restrictions on banks' investments in securities.
All financial institutions will be demanded to join in national despositary insurance system.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Enterprises will be able to directly develop commercial zones.
Taiwan-South Korea relations are expected to thaw.
